about: Roosevelt: small round spectacles over the walrus moustache. The spectacles, the moustache and the face are his texture's own, with the folds drawn in by the bake; pictured at 192 pixels a metre the rims hold together. Only an eye is drawn behind each lens, where the texture has a pale smudge. Nothing is laid on his low-poly mesh: it models its own spectacles. (Until faces were made clear the band his eyes sit in was painted skin and big round rims were drawn over it; that read as goggles.)
